description.narrative: El impacto esperado es contribuir a mejorar la insercin laboral de jvenes participantes de las nuevas modalidades de capacitacin; y el resultado esperado es mejorar la capacidad de la DGE de articular servicios a travs de la ventanilla nica.

The expected impact is to help improve job placement for young people who participate in new training models, and the expected outcome is to build the capacity of the General Employment Directorate (DGE) to coordinate services through a one-stop window.
